description: This PHP file is part of the TestLink project and handles the assignment and display of test cases assigned to users, including functionality for filtering, editing, and executing test cases within the test management environment. It manages user input, database interactions, and dynamically generates tables and links for test case management.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A template class instance used for rendering templates and managing presentation logic.

classes.name: tlObjectWithDB
classes.description: A database utility class providing static methods for database table retrieval.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class for creating and managing external tables with features like sorting, grouping, and toolbar controls.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Manages test project data from the database.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user in the system with methods to read user data from the database.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Handles test case data and retrieval from the database, including get_assigned_to_user and get_last_execution methods.

methods.name: get_date_diff
methods.description: Calculates the difference in days between the current time and a given date.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes arguments from request/session data into an object, handling input sanitization and setting default values.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object with project info, localization strings, and user options, preparing for rendering.

methods.name: getStatusGuiCfg
methods.description: Retrieves and structures configuration for status display, including labels and CSS classes.

methods.name: getQuickExecCfg
methods.description: Provides HTML snippets for quick execution icons for test case results.
